assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA pairs that site-specifically install designed non-canonical amino acids turned the genetic code into an engineering platform. From a designed-protein and peptide-materials viewpoint it is foundational: it enables bioorthogonal handles, photocrosslinkers and new chemistries in proteins in living cells, with wide use in biophysics, biomaterials and therapeutics.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the first in vivo bacterial and eukaryotic systems; Chin extended them to multiple, quadruplet and ribosome-engineered codes and to eukaryotes and animals; Yokoyama contributed structure-guided synthetase engineering and pyrrolysyl systems. Wang and Mehl were important early contributors, so a three-person cut involves a judgement about who was decisive that I cannot fully verify.
assessment.maturity: Over two decades of independent adoption in hundreds of labs and in clinical-stage antibody-drug conjugates and biologics; the field is mature and the timing is not premature.
uncertainties: Credit among Schultz, Chin, Wang, Mehl and Yokoyama is not cleanly separable and I am relying on recalled history.
Pyrrolysine-based systems and the Schultz-lab originating work may be seen as separate contributions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors convert targeted C-G to T-A and A-T to G-C without double-strand breaks by fusing a deaminase to a Cas protein. This is a clear, original chemical-biology invention built on protein engineering and directed evolution, with immediate therapeutic reach, including clinical trials and a first approved in vivo-edited therapies lineage.
assessment.attribution: Liu is the clear intellectual leader and inventor; Komor and Gaudelli were lead trainee authors of the cytosine and adenine editors and Nishida/Kondo reported an independent deaminase-Cas fusion. A prize naturally names Liu alone, which matches how such recognition would likely be framed.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent validation across many organisms and growing clinical data; the translational record is accumulating but long-term safety (off-target deamination) is still being assessed. Timing is plausible rather than premature.
uncertainties: Whether the committee views this as chemistry rather than medicine or physiology, and whether it would be bundled with prime editing (B018) or with CRISPR already recognised in 2020.
Overlap with the 2020 CRISPR prize may weigh against.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation reframes drug action as event-driven chemistry: bifunctional PROTACs and molecular glues recruit E3 ligases to destroy proteins formerly considered undruggable. It combines designed molecular recognition with a mechanistic discovery (cereblon as thalidomide target) and has a very large translational footprint.
assessment.attribution: Crews (with Sakamoto and Deshaies) introduced PROTACs; Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target underlying glue degraders; Ciulli delivered the structure-guided VHL-based PROTACs and mechanistic cooperativity work. Deshaies, Sakamoto, Gray, Kim and Ito were also significant, so the three-name configuration leaves real unresolved credit.
assessment.maturity: Many degraders are in clinical trials with early positive data, but no PROTAC is yet approved to my knowledge; the concept is strongly confirmed, clinical validation is still maturing.
uncertainties: Approved-drug validation for bifunctional degraders is uncertain; glues (lenalidomide) had clinical success earlier than the mechanism was understood, complicating credit.
Priority dispute between PROTAC and glue branches.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the enabling delivery chemistry for siRNA and mRNA medicines, including COVID-19 vaccines. The molecular design of pH-responsive lipids, self-assembly and endosomal escape is a compelling example of molecular materials chemistry with direct societal impact, close to my translational and nanomaterials interests.
assessment.attribution: Cullis and colleagues (Madden, Hope, MacLachlan) developed the early ionizable-lipid and microfluidic formulation approaches; Anderson and Langer contributed combinatorial lipid-like materials discovery. Cullis is the most defensible central figure; allocating the second slot is contested and dependent on patents and industrial history I cannot verify.
assessment.maturity: Validated at global scale by approved products; the scientific base is mature and recognition would be timely, though the 2023 Medicine prize already recognised the mRNA side.
uncertainties: Industrial and patent-driven credit disputes among many contributors.
Risk the committee sees this as a medicine/pharmaceutics achievement or as overshadowed by the 2023 Medicine prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Scaffolded DNA origami and tile/brick strategies made it possible to design arbitrary nanoscale shapes by programmed base-pairing, a landmark of molecular self-assembly with uses in biosensing, nanoplasmonic arrangement, drug delivery and structural biology.
assessment.attribution: Rothemund introduced 2D scaffolded origami; Shih and Yan extended to 3D; Yin and Winfree contributed tile/brick and algorithmic assembly. Seeman's foundational DNA nanotechnology is not in the credited list, which complicates a fair prize framing within the supplied names.
assessment.maturity: Widely reproduced for nearly two decades; applications beyond structural demonstrations are still developing, but the core concept is stable.
uncertainties: Credit for foundational DNA nanotechnology outside the credited list may make this configuration incomplete.
Practical impact is less established than the design concept.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Liquid-liquid phase separation as an organizing principle for membraneless compartments reshaped cell biology and physical chemistry of biomolecules, and connects directly to my work on peptide self-assembly and condensed phases.
assessment.attribution: Brangwynne and Hyman showed P granules behave as liquids; Rosen's multivalent-interaction model supplied physical-chemical rationale; Pappu and Mittag contributed sequence-encoded theory and grammar. Credit is broad and disputed.
assessment.maturity: Rapid field growth, but active debate on the physiological relevance, in-cell measurement and condensate definitions suggests the interpretation is not yet fully stable.
uncertainties: Debate over in vivo phase separation versus other assembly mechanisms.
May be judged better suited to physiology or medicine.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sensing from alpha-hemolysin pores to commercial long-read DNA/RNA sequencing is a molecular-engineering success at the intersection of biophysics and analytical chemistry, aligned with my interest in biosensors and engineered molecular recognition.
assessment.attribution: Kasianowicz/Branton/Deamer showed single-stranded DNA translocation; Bayley engineered protein pores and sensing chemistry; Akeson demonstrated enzyme-controlled DNA movement enabling sequencing. Allocation among founders and engineers is unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Commercialised and widely used; the foundational demonstrations are over two decades old and clearly confirmed.
uncertainties: Several of the pioneers' roles overlap, and I am uncertain of the current status of each credited person.
Sequencing applications may be seen as engineering rather than discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: DNA-programmed nanoparticle assembly and spherical nucleic acids merge biomolecular recognition with gold nanoparticles, giving colorimetric biosensing, intracellular gene regulation and programmable crystal engineering. This is close to the nanoparticle-biomolecule hybrid field of my own research.
assessment.attribution: Mirkin with Mucic and Storhoff reported DNA-gold nanoparticle assembly and detection, and Alivisatos independently reported DNA-nanocrystal assemblies in the same year. Mirkin is the sustained leader on spherical nucleic acids.
assessment.maturity: Core concept confirmed by many groups and by commercial diagnostics, but clinical translation of spherical nucleic acids is less established.
uncertainties: Joint priority with Alivisatos is plausible but may be viewed as better fitted to a nanocrystal prize.
